data_status: Synthetic demo configuration, not facts about a real retailer.
usage_notes: Use documents as factual context for response generation. Do not use previous generated responses as verified facts.
related_intents are selection metadata; omit them from the model prompt.
Missing information means unknown, not that a service does not exist.
Customer-specific order status must come from the existing order tool, not this static collection.
Select relevant documents for each request; document selection by intent is an initial integration step, not semantic retrieval.
All newly defined procedures and hours are deliberate demo assumptions. Existing support contact values are preserved from the pilot.

documents.title: Customer support
documents.content: Demo Retail customer support can be reached at support@example.com or +1-202-555-0147. Support hours are Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Eastern Time. These are customer-support hours, not physical-store opening hours. The website is https://shop.example.com.

documents.title: Central demo store opening hours
documents.content: Demo Retail has a fictional demo branch named Central, identified by store_id central. Its regular shopping hours are Monday–Saturday, 10:00–18:00, and Sunday, 12:00–16:00, in the America/Toronto time zone. Holiday opening hours and its street address have not been provided. These hours apply only to Central; opening hours for other locations have not been provided.

documents.title: Returns for ordinary merchandise
documents.content: Under this demo policy, unused ordinary merchandise with its original packaging can be submitted for return within 30 calendar days of delivery. Proof of purchase is required. Final-sale items are excluded. Customers can email support@example.com with their order number and the item they wish to return to request instructions. This request is not a return approval. Return-shipping charges and refund-processing times have not been specified.

documents.title: Requesting an invoice
documents.content: To request an invoice from Demo Retail, email support@example.com with the order number. The support team handles invoice requests. An invoice-download feature on the website has not been documented, and no delivery time for an invoice has been specified.

documents.title: Submitting a product complaint
documents.content: Customers can submit a product complaint by emailing support@example.com. Include the product name, a description of the issue, and the order number if available. The assistant can help draft the complaint, but sending a chat message does not submit it to support. A complaint web form and department-routing options have not been documented.

documents.title: Requesting account closure
documents.content: To request account closure, contact support@example.com from the email address registered to the account. Support handles verification and the closure request. A self-service Close Account button has not been documented. Data-retention rules and the time required to close an account have not been specified. The assistant cannot claim that an account has been closed without a successful action result.

documents.title: Password reset procedure
documents.content: For this demo store, open the website login page and select Forgot Password. Enter the registered email address and follow the reset instructions sent to that address. Choose a strong, unique password. Do not share passwords or reset codes in chat. If the reset cannot be completed, contact support@example.com. Resetting a password alone does not establish that every consequence of a compromised account has been resolved.

documents.title: Information not yet available
documents.content: This collection contains no current sale dates, discount offers, physical-store street addresses, store-locator feature description, or live product-stock records. Do not infer these details from typical retail practice. Support contact details are available in the customer-support document.
